name: [🔒QOL UPDATE🔒] Dungeon Leveling
desc:
❗This game is very HARD Play at your own risk ❗

Try a unique Dungeon RPG with a realistic combat system. The project is trying to recreate the atmosphere of old MMORPGs. 

There are 6 classes in the game, each class has its own weapons and unique abilities. 
-🛡️Tank
-🏹 Ranger
-🪄 Wizard
-🗡️Assassin
-⚔️Warrior
-❤️‍🩹Healer

Complete modularly generated dungeons. 
You will need to decide whether to move on or not, since when you die you lose the items found in the dungeon
